command: 90 sequential 4096-byte appends at a minimum 33.333 ms cadence; time synchronization separately; ordinary christopherdavid process
setup: Root allocated one 1 MiB extent beyond EOF in a dedicated scratch file, then transferred ownership. The probe ran as the ordinary user without capabilities. No filesystem reservations changed.
limitations: Sequential short probes on a shared host; no causal whole-battle improvement established.
The loop filesystem uses an ext4 backing file on ext4 NVMe; direct probe bypasses that nested filesystem.
Both battle checkouts already use Linux fdatasync for journal appends.
